properties.title: Hanover St corridor
properties.text: 1BR: $2,800–$3,400/mo · 2BR: $3,800–$4,600/mo. High demand due to walkability and restaurant scene. Expect bidding wars on anything under $3,000.

properties.title: Prince St / North End core
properties.text: Studio: $2,200–$2,700/mo · 1BR: $2,900–$3,500/mo. Older brick walk-ups, few amenities. Premium for renovated units. Leases turn over fast in spring.

properties.title: Commercial Wharf / Waterfront
properties.text: 1BR: $3,500–$4,800/mo · 2BR: $5,200–$7,000/mo. Luxury condos and renovated loft conversions. Harbor views add 15–25% premium. Very low vacancy.

properties.title: Bowdoin / Govt Center
properties.text: Studio: $2,000–$2,500/mo · 1BR: $2,600–$3,200/mo. Mix of older stock and newer high-rises. More affordable than waterfront. Good T access keeps demand steady.

properties.title: Salem St / Prado area
properties.text: 1BR: $2,600–$3,200/mo · 2BR: $3,400–$4,200/mo. Quieter end of the North End. Fewer tourists, more locals. Units here tend to stay rented year to year.
